entries.rationale: The current artifact-state inspection slice still uses the legacy projection; relocate it during final ownership cleanup.
Service source segmentation still shares established instruction-ledger semantics; move the product-semantic implementation and fixtures during final package cleanup.
Service source segmentation still shares established instruction-ledger semantics; move the product-semantic implementation and fixtures during final package cleanup.
Planning maps the existing provider execution error into its stable planning outcome; replace it with a service-owned error type during provider extraction.
The service still reuses the existing actual Structrr diff implementation; relocate it with the remaining Structrr product semantics.
The service-owned multi-PR proposal still consumes the existing Structrr diff record; relocate it with Structrr policy.
Bootstrap still reuses the existing Structrr implementation over a service-owned snapshot; relocate it with the remaining Structrr product semantics.
The service-owned proposal reconciliation still uses the existing Structrr candidate comparison; relocate it with Structrr policy.
The service-owned multi-PR proposal still uses the established Structrr proposal record; relocate it with Structrr policy.
The service-owned multi-PR proposal still uses the established Structrr compiler; relocate it with Structrr policy.
The service-owned multi-PR proposal still uses the existing Structrr rebase algorithm; relocate it with Structrr policy.
Planning reuses Structrr canonical snapshot digests so proposed changes retain existing digest identity; this canonicalization helper still needs relocation to service-owned Structrr code.
Actual Structrr diff compilation still uses the existing source-manifest type; move the type with the service-owned Structrr implementation.
Planning uses the established workflow slug function for stable work-item IDs; moving that deterministic policy must preserve IDs stored in plans and issues.
The legacy bounded JSON completion helper owns provider retry behavior; planning will consume the service inference contract after provider extraction.
Planning uses the existing Procedrr client for bounded model-backed questions; provider and private process runtime ownership is scheduled for inference-boundary extraction.
Planning executes private Procedrr operations through the legacy executor; move this provider/process runtime behind the service inference boundary.
Planning consumes the legacy workflow LLM protocol until its request/response path is replaced by the serializable service inference contract.
